# Perturbation-Specific Figures 4,5,6,7 components (C) Heatmaps and (D) Volcano Plots for RNA DEGs.

# Imports
```{r imports}
library(MuDataSeurat)
library(Seurat)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
devtools::install_github("reetm09/MixscaleBH")
library(MixscaleBH)
library(presto)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(magick)
library(svglite)
```

# Read Objects
``` {r read_objects}

# Read in objects
data_dir = "<path to processed data>"
rna_img <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir,"rna_imgl_clean_mixscaled.rds"))
rna_itf <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir,"rna_6tf_clean_mixscaled.rds"))

```


# Get Levels
``` {r get_levels}
# Get levels
levels_pert_genes_rna_img <- levels(rna_img$perturbed_gene)
levels_pert_genes_rna_itf <- levels(rna_itf$perturbed_gene)
```

# Read DEG dataframes
``` {r read_deg_dfs}
# Read in DEG dataframes
de_res_rna_6tf_all <- list()
for (perturbed_gene in levels_pert_genes_6tf) {
    de_res_path <- paste0("<path to deg directory>","merged_6tf_mixscale_degs_all_rna_", perturbed_gene, ".csv")
    if (!file.exists(de_res_path)) {
        print(paste0("File does not exist for gene: ", perturbed_gene))
        next
    }
    de_res <- read.csv(de_res_path)
    de_res_rna_6tf_all[[perturbed_gene]] <- de_res
}

de_res_rna_img_all <- list()
for (perturbed_gene in levels_pert_genes_6tf) {
    de_res_path <- paste0("<path to deg directory>","cite_imgl_mixscale_degs_all_rna_", perturbed_gene, ".csv")
    if (!file.exists(de_res_path)) {
        print(paste0("File does not exist for gene: ", perturbed_gene))
        next
    }
    de_res <- read.csv(de_res_path)
    de_res_rna_img_all[[perturbed_gene]] <- de_res
}
```

# Define Signatures and Colors
```{r define_signatures}
signature_path <- "<path to reference state gene families, table S2 tab 2>"

signature_df <- read.csv(signature_path)
ifn_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Interferon != ""),]$Interferon
dam_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Disease.responsive != ""),]$Disease.responsive
chem_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Chemokine != ""),]$Chemokine
hom_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Homeostatic != ""),]$Homeostatic
ldam_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Lipid.high != ""),]$Lipid.high
ap_genes <- signature_df[(signature_df$Antigen.presenting != ""),]$Antigen.presenting

colmap <- c(
    DAM = "#BF0063",
    HOM = "#107B35",
    IFN = "#5FADAF",
    CHM = "#A335C2",
    LDM = "#E76333",
    APR = "#FDAC10",
    NSIG = "#D6D6D6",
    OTH = "#666666"
)
```

# Volcano Plots
``` {r volcano_plots}

log2fcutoff <- 0
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05

#genes_to_include = c("DNMT1", "STAT2", "SMAD3", "IRF9")

# Volcano plots for iTF
volcano_plots_6tf <- list()
for (perturbed_gene in levels_pert_genes_6tf) {
#for (perturbed_gene in genes_to_include) {
    if (!perturbed_gene %in% names(de_res_rna_6tf_all)) {
        print(paste0("No DEG results for gene: ", perturbed_gene))
        next
    }
    de_res <- de_res_rna_6tf_all[[perturbed_gene]]
    
    if (!all(c("log2FC", "adj_p_weight", "gene_ID") %in% colnames(de_res))) {
        print(paste0("Missing columns in DEG results for gene: ", perturbed_gene))
        next
    }
    cat <- ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% hom_genes, "HOM",
         ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% ifn_genes, "IFN",
         ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% dam_genes, "DAM",
         ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% chem_genes, "CHM",
         ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% ldam_genes, "LDM",
         ifelse(de_res$gene_ID %in% ap_genes,  "APR", 
         ifelse(de_res$adj_p_weight > fdr_cutoff, "NSIG","OTH")))))))
    de_res$cat <- cat
    
    de_res_ordered <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::filter(de_res, cat == "NSIG"),
    dplyr::filter(de_res, cat == "OTH"),
    dplyr::filter(de_res, cat %in% c("OTH", "NSIG") == FALSE)
  )
    
    # Create volcano plot
    keyvals <- unname(colmap[de_res_ordered$cat])
    names(keyvals) <- de_res_ordered$cat  # legend labels
    p <- EnhancedVolcano(de_res_ordered,
                         lab = de_res_ordered$gene_ID,
                         x = 'log2FC',
                         y = 'adj_p_weight',
                         title = paste0('Volcano Plot Mixscale Weighted - iTF - ', perturbed_gene),
                         pCutoff = fdr_cutoff,
                         FCcutoff = log2fcutoff,
                         pointSize = 3.0,
                         labSize = 3.0,
                         cutoffLineWidth = 0.6,
                         colCustom = keyvals,
                         selectLab = de_res_ordered[order(de_res_ordered$adj_p_weight), ]$gene_ID[1:40],
                         drawConnectors = TRUE,
                         colAlpha = 1.0,
                         gridlines.major = FALSE,
                         gridlines.minor = FALSE,
                         legendPosition = "none",
                         arrowheads = FALSE,
                         max.overlaps = 20,
                         xlim = c(round(min(de_res_ordered$log2FC)) - 0.5, round(max(de_res_ordered$log2FC)) + 0.5),
                         ylim = c(0, max(-log10(de_res_ordered$adj_p_weight), na.rm = TRUE) + 1)
                         #ylim = c(0, 50)
                         )
    
    volcano_plots_6tf[[perturbed_gene]] <- p
    fig_dir = "../figures/iTF/final/"
    save_pdf_path = paste0(fig_dir, perturbed_gene,"_rna_volcano_iTF_labelled.pdf")
    save_svg_path <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(perturbed_gene, "_rna_volcano_iTF_labelled.svg"))
    svglite(save_svg_path, width = 8, height = 8)
    plot(p)
    dev.off()
    
}
```

# Build Heatmap Function
``` {r build_heatmap_function}

# Function to plot custom complex Heatmap for given target gene
plot_mixscale_heatmap <- function(target,
                                  mixscaled_seurat_obj,
                                  de_res_all_dict,
                                  fig_dir,
                                  assay_name = "rna",
                                  mixscale_col = "mixscale_score",
                                  perturb_col = "perturbed_gene",
                                  nt_name = "NTC",
                                  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
                                  gene_col = "gene_ID",
                                  top_n_pos = 25,
                                  top_n_neg = 25,
                                  save_pdf_path = paste0(fig_dir, target,"_mixscale_heatmap_subsampled.pdf"),
                                  save_svg_path = paste0(fig_dir, target, "_mixscale_heatmap_subsampled.svg")
) {
  
  md <- mixscaled_seurat_obj@meta.data
  stopifnot(
    "Seurat" %in% class(mixscaled_seurat_obj),
    assay_name %in% names(mixscaled_seurat_obj@assays),
    mixscale_col %in% colnames(md),
    perturb_col %in% colnames(md)
  )
    
  de_res_target <- de_res_all_dict[[target]] %>%
    filter(!is.na(adj_p_weight), !is.na(log2FC))

  if (nrow(de_res_target) == 0) stop("DE table for target is empty after NA filtering.")
  
  # apply FDR filter once
  de_res_target_sig <- de_res_target %>% filter(adj_p_weight <= fdr_cutoff)
  
  # pick top up/down genes
  top_pos <- de_res_target_sig %>%
    filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
    arrange(adj_p_weight, desc(log2FC)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_pos) %>%
    pull(.data[[gene_col]])

  top_neg <- de_res_target_sig %>%
    filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
    arrange(adj_p_weight, log2FC) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_neg) %>%
    pull(.data[[gene_col]])

  top_genes <- unique(c(top_pos, top_neg))
  features  <- unique(c(target, top_genes))

  # Scale only features
  scaled_mixscaled_seurat_obj <- ScaleData(
    mixscaled_seurat_obj, assay = assay_name,features = features,
    #do.center = TRUE, do.scale = TRUE
    )
  
  # assay matrix (log-normalized data)
  rna_mat <- GetAssayData(scaled_mixscaled_seurat_obj, assay = assay_name, slot = "scale.data")[features, ]
  rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_mat)  # ComplexHeatmap wants base matrix
  
  # keep only genes that exist
  features <- intersect(features, rownames(rna_mat))
  if (length(features) == 0) stop("None of the selected features are present in the assay matrix.")
  
  # main heatmap matrix
  mat <- rna_mat[features, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # grouping
  is_nt          <- md[[perturb_col]] == nt_name
  is_target_pert <- md[[perturb_col]] == target
  
  grp <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(mixscaled_seurat_obj))
  grp[is_nt]          <- nt_name
  grp[is_target_pert] <- target
  
  mixscore <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(md[[mixscale_col]]))
  
  # keep only labeled columns with non-NA mixscore and matching colnames
  keep <- !is.na(grp) & is.finite(mixscore) & (mixscore >= 0) & (colnames(mixscaled_seurat_obj) %in% colnames(mat))
  if (!any(keep)) stop("No cells remain after filtering for groups and mixscale.")
  
  grp      <- grp[keep]
  mixscore <- mixscore[keep]
  mat      <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  # random subsampling to equalize group sizes
  set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility
  nt_idx      <- which(grp == nt_name)
  target_idx  <- which(grp == target)
  
  n_to_sample <- min(length(nt_idx), length(target_idx), 1000)
  
  nt_idx_sub     <- sample(nt_idx, n_to_sample)
  target_idx_sub <- sample(target_idx, n_to_sample)
  
  sel_idx <- c(nt_idx_sub, target_idx_sub)
  
  grp      <- grp[sel_idx]
  mixscore <- mixscore[sel_idx]
  mat      <- mat[, sel_idx, drop = FALSE]
  
  # order by group, then within group by Mixscale
  ord <- order(grp, mixscore)
  grp <- factor(grp[ord], levels = c(nt_name, target))
  mixscore <- mixscore[ord]
  mat <- mat[, ord, drop = FALSE]
  
  hm_colors <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#FF00FF", "black", "#FFFF00"))
  grp_levels <- levels(grp)
  grp_colors <- setNames(c("#CCCCCC", "#9D2937")[seq_along(grp_levels)], grp_levels)
  
  #no more clipping
  #mix_lim <- 2
  #mixscore_clip <- pmax(pmin(mixscore, mix_lim), -mix_lim)
  
  histogram <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Group = grp,
    `Mixscale` = anno_barplot(
      mixscore,
      #ylim = c(-mix_lim, mix_lim),
      baseline = 0,
      gp = gpar(fill = "grey40", col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      height = unit(12, "mm"),
      axis_param = list(at = c(round(min(mixscore)), 0, round(max(mixscore))), labels = c(round(min(mixscore)),"0",round(max(mixscore))))
    ),
    col = list(Group = grp_colors),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_legend_param = list(Group = list(title = "Perturbation"))
  )
  
  
  # row order: put target perturbation on top, then top neg, then top pos by DEGs
  row_order_names <- c(target, setdiff(c(top_neg, top_pos), target))
  row_order_names <- unique(row_order_names[row_order_names %in% rownames(mat)])
  
  mat <- mat[row_order_names, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # keep target bold in labels:
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = ifelse(rownames(mat) == target, "bold", "plain"))

  ht <- Heatmap(
    mat,
    name = "Expression (z)",
    col = hm_colors,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(
      fontface = ifelse(rownames(mat) == target, "bold", "plain")
    ),
    column_split = grp,
    column_gap = unit(c(2, 2), "mm"),
    top_annotation = histogram,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Expression (z)", at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2))
  )
  
  save_svg_path <- file.path(save_svg_path)
  svglite(save_svg_path, width = 8, height = 8)
  draw(ht)
  dev.off()
  
}


```
